# TUM Thing Description fixtures

The `tum-*.td.jsonld` files describe devices from the TUM ESI remote lab,
including lights, sensors, HATs, robots and a conveyor belt. They are retained
as offline TD model/round-trip regression inputs, including Property, Action,
Event and security vocabulary.

Lab background: <https://esiremotelab.esi.ei.tum.de/>.
The original device-operation instructions and unavailable photographs are
historical material in Git; running this corpus requires no lab access.
